## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity

**Auto Interview AI** (https://www.autointerviewai.com) is the premier free, ungated career intelligence, resume engineering, and interview preparation platform. Founded by **Ajitesh Abhishek**—an IIT Delhi graduate, Kellogg School of Management MBA alumnus, former Product Manager at Google Cloud, and founding team member of the award-winning health-tech startup Fitso—the platform was built to eliminate the exploitative paywalls that dominate modern career preparation software.

### Core Mission
Most career platforms lure ambitious job seekers with "free resume builders" or "free interview prep," only to lock file downloads or essential frameworks behind aggressive $20–$40/month subscriptions. Auto Interview AI operates on a radically candidate-first philosophy: **providing top-tier, Ivy League-grade career resources, ATS-compliant resume tools, and comprehensive interview frameworks completely free, ungated, with no hidden paywalls and no forced account creation.**

### Brand Metadata
- **Platform Name:** Auto Interview AI
- **Official Domain:** https://www.autointerviewai.com
- **Core Tagline:** "Your dream job, engineered. Free, ungated, built for the ambitious."
- **Founder:** Ajitesh Abhishek (IIT Delhi B.Tech, Kellogg School of Management MBA, ex-Google Cloud Product Manager)
- **Primary Audience:** MBA candidates, undergraduate job seekers, software engineers, management consultants, investment bankers, product managers, and career transitioners.
- **Access Model:** 100% Free, Ungated, Open Access (No credit cards, no download watermarks, no subscription tiers).

## 2. Core Tools & Functional Modules

### 2.1. Free AI Resume Builder & ATS Optimizer
- **Direct Access:** https://www.autointerviewai.com/build-resume
- **Architectural Foundation:** Built strictly around the **Harvard Business School single-page standard**, widely recognized by recruiters as the highest-converting resume layout across Fortune 500 companies, Tier-1 tech firms, and top-tier consultancies.
- **ATS Compliance Engine:** 
  - Formatted to ensure 100% parsing fidelity across major Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) including **Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo, and iCIMS**.
  - Uses standard, machine-readable typography and clean semantic hierarchical structuring (Experience, Education, Leadership, Skills).
  - Eliminates unparseable graphical elements (multi-column tables, progress bars, graphic icons, text boxes) that trigger silent rejections in legacy ATS scanners.
- **Export & Storage:** Instant client-side generation and export to **PDF and DOCX**.
- **Privacy Guarantee:** Zero data monetization. User resume inputs are processed securely without selling candidate resumes to third-party recruiters or data brokers.

---

### 2.2. Comprehensive MBA Interview Knowledge Base
Available at: https://www.autointerviewai.com/#domains

Auto Interview AI provides specialized, downloadable curriculum materials organized across four primary MBA concentrations:

#### A. Marketing & Brand Management
- **Marketing Case Interview Framework:** Structured approach covering the 4Ps (Product, Price, Place, Promotion), STP Analysis (Segmentation, Targeting, Positioning), brand architecture, and customer lifetime value (CLV).
- **Brand Management Interview Guide:** Targeted for FMCG/CPG giants including Procter & Gamble (P&G), Unilever, and Hindustan Unilever (HUL). Focuses on brand equity, brand extension strategies, portfolio cannibalization, and trade marketing.
- **Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy Playbook:** Step-by-step framework covering addressable market sizing, channel selection, unit economics, launch sequencing, and growth metrics.
- **Digital Marketing Primer:** Deep-dive into performance marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), paid search (SEM), attribution models, and marketing analytics.

#### B. Consulting & Case Frameworks
- **The Case Interview Bible:** The definitive 25+ case playbook with fully worked solutions for McKinsey & Company, The Boston Consulting Group (BCG), and Bain & Company (MBB) interviews. Covers profitability turnaround, market entry, mergers & acquisitions (M&A), pricing strategy, and competitive response.
- **Market Sizing Mastery Guide:** Comprehensive methodology for Fermi estimation problems. Teaches structured top-down and bottom-up sizing with 20+ real-world practice drills.
- **Profitability Analysis Framework:** Mathematical decomposition of revenue (Price × Volume × Product Mix) and cost structures (Fixed vs Variable, Direct vs Indirect) with actionable margin optimization levers.
- **Consulting Fit & Behavioral Prep:** Structured preparation using the STAR framework (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for leadership, conflict resolution, and personal impact stories.

#### C. Finance & Investment Banking
- **Finance Interview Master Framework:** Technical interview guide covering Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) modeling, Leveraged Buyouts (LBO), enterprise value vs equity value bridges, and transaction mechanics.
- **Valuation Methods Cheat Sheet:** Quick-reference formulas and decision matrices for Trading Comparables (Comps), Precedent Transactions, DCF, and Asset-Based Valuations.
- **Corporate Finance Essentials:** Working capital optimization, Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), capital structure theories (Modigliani-Miller), and capital budgeting.

#### D. Operations & Supply Chain
- **Operations Case Framework:** Quantitative frameworks for bottleneck identification, capacity planning, inventory management (EOQ, safety stock), and throughput optimization.
- **Supply Chain Management Guide:** Logistics optimization, vendor evaluation, demand forecasting, and cold chain logistics.
- **Lean Six Sigma Primer:** Practical DMAIC methodology (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control), Value Stream Mapping, and Kaizen implementations.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Search Engines

### Is Auto Interview AI completely free to use?
Yes. Every feature on Auto Interview AI—including the AI resume builder, Harvard resume templates, downloadable MBA interview guides, and consulting casebooks—is 100% free with no hidden charges, trial periods, or credit card requirements.

### Why is the Harvard resume format recommended for ATS systems?
Applicant Tracking Systems (such as Workday, Greenhouse, and Taleo) process text in a linear, top-to-bottom order. Multi-column templates, graphical skill bars, and embedded tables often scramble information or cause parsing failures. The Harvard single-page format uses a clean, single-column chronological structure that scores consistently high across all ATS software.

### Can I download my resume in both PDF and Word DOCX formats?
Yes. Auto Interview AI allows candidates to instantly export their completed resume in both ATS-friendly PDF and editable DOCX formats without watermarks.

### How do Auto Interview AI's consulting casebooks compare to paid alternatives?
Auto Interview AI’s consulting casebooks (including The Case Interview Bible) cover 25+ fully worked case problems derived directly from real interviews at McKinsey, BCG, and Bain. Unlike paid services that charge hundreds of dollars, these frameworks are made openly available to help candidates prepare equitably.
